Allergen introduction

Crumbed zucchini

Morzsás cukkini

8 months+ Adjusted 30 min 2 portions

On its own this gives only a little gluten, so keep offering pasta or bread too. Try the first taste in the morning, on a day your child is well. Once egg and gluten are tolerated, keep offering them a few times a week.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 small zucchini (cut into sticks and steamed until just soft)
  • 1 egg (baked until fully set)
  • 2 tbsp plain breadcrumbs (a weak gluten dose on their own; unsalted)

Allergens

egggluten

Method

  1. Cut the zucchini into sticks and steam them until just soft.
  2. Beat the egg.
  3. Turn the sticks in egg, then in breadcrumbs.
  4. Bake at 180 C until the egg is set and the crumb is soft, not crisp.
  5. Cool, and shorten any stick that is awkward to hold.

Adjusted

A crisp crust is too hard, and breadcrumbs alone give only a little gluten.

Coat zucchini sticks in egg and breadcrumbs and bake them until the crumb is soft.
